company.name: Qulture.Rocks
company.shortDescription: Qulture.Rocks builds people management applications for some of the world's most influential companies.
company.description: Qulture.Rocks is a San-Francisco based software company that builds people management applications for some of the world's most influential companies. Its platform enables organizations to implement 1:1s, goals/OKRs, performance reviews, 360-degree and ongoing, on-the-spot feedback and recognition.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based system that replaces manual spreadsheets and forms to manage employee performance evaluations, enabling strategic decision-making and talent identification.
productsAndServices.name: Performance Evaluation

productsAndServices.description: A platform to organize, track, and align company, team, and individual objectives and key results (OKRs) with customizable dashboards and action plans.
productsAndServices.name: Goals and OKRs Management

productsAndServices.description: A tool to define personalized development priorities and paths for employees, supporting motivation and skill growth through tailored action plans.
productsAndServices.name: Individual Development Plan (PDI)

productsAndServices.description: A platform to facilitate regular one-on-one meetings between leaders and their team members, supporting agenda setting, note-taking, and task tracking.
productsAndServices.name: 1:1 Meetings Management

productsAndServices.description: A system to encourage continuous feedback exchange among employees to support ongoing development and performance improvement.
productsAndServices.name: Feedbacks

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that allows public recognition of employee achievements and contributions within the organization.
productsAndServices.name: Compliments (Elogios)

aiResearchSummary.text: Qulture.Rocks is focused on enhancing leadership qualities through a system that assesses and develops leadership skills. The system is designed to process leadership events derived from performance data. This innovation aims to optimize leadership development by leveraging a computer-implemented server to manage and improve leadership capabilities, aligning with the company's goal of advancing people management applications.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,301,419 to $4,508,704, a 1.96x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 30 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 16 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
